reward_units.training: macro scalar = mean over the 10 host steps of the adapter scalar (contract team r / 6)
reward_units.readings: team per-step r = 0.5 * (C_bh + S/D), every host step

counter_definitions.decisions: UAV-level macro decisions (6 per macro step)
counter_definitions.far_target_decisions: decisions whose held target is > 300 m (3-D) from the UAV's position at decision time
counter_definitions.target_changes: re-decisions (macro step >= 1) whose target differs from the previously held target by > 1e-06 m
counter_definitions.redecisions: UAV-level decisions at macro steps >= 1 (denominator of the target-change rate)
counter_definitions.slot_conflicts: slot contract: per macro step, 6 minus the number of distinct slots chosen (UAVs duplicating an already-chosen slot), summed
counter_definitions.slot_switches: slot contract: re-decisions whose slot differs from the previously held slot
counter_definitions.offset_box_clips: offset contract: UAV-decisions whose anchor + offset left the arena box and was clipped to it
